WITH latest_snaps AS (
    SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
),
latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT * FROM breadth.ma_pct_above

)

FROM latest_snaps ss

GROUP BY ss.sector
ORDER BY stage2_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
